encoding_notes.adc_b_masks: 5.9 ADC_B convention: external n -> bit n; internal n -> bit (32+n-96). HM Tables 54.4/54.5 include S&H self-diagnosis and per-unit diagnosis channels.
encoding_notes.cache: CPU1 C-Cache supports write-through/write-back, so CODE_CACHE_VERSION=2; CPU0 uses its Arm cache.
encoding_notes.rom_waits: FLWT and FACI ROM wait tables do not exist. MRAM uses MRCFREQ/MREFREQ, not old ROM wait thresholds.
encoding_notes.ethernet: ETHERC/EDMAC/MII/RMII flags are zero: ESWM/RMAC/GWCA is a different IP. Generic Ethernet limits retain two ports and eight RX descriptor queues.
encoding_notes.sci: HM39.1 and physical module addresses expose channels0..9; HM14.5 allocates SCI10/11 event codes, retained in event enum but not marked as physical channels.
encoding_notes.momcr: MOMCR bit4 must be one. CGC_MAINCLOCK_DRIVE_RESERVED_MASK=0x08 before MODRV0_Pos=1 shift; MODRV_MASK includes physical bit4=0x10.
encoding_notes.counts: Counts exclude valueless include guards. Original value counts are 483 features and 186 peripherals; reviewed registry extensions are added uniformly to all MCUs.
encoding_notes.dac_units: HM55.2 exposes DACn_B at a 0x100 stride for n=0,1; each unit has one DADR and one output channel. DAC_B/DAC12 counts are 2 units x 1 channel; 0x3 selects both independently addressable units.
encoding_notes.pdm_channels: BSP_FEATURE_PDM_CHANNELS is the existing new-driver channel-mask contract (0x7), not a numeric channel count; HM50.1 provides three channels 0..2.
